title: Pip and the Sandcastle Sorry Rhyme
moral: When we say sorry and help fix things, our friendships grow even stronger.
description: Pip and Tumble spend a sunny day at Sunny Bay beach, building sandcastles and playing a silly rhyme game. But one big BOING of a beach ball changes everything! Learn rhyming words like sun and fun, shell and bell, and boat, goat and coat in this funny animated story about saying sorry, for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Guess where Pip and Tumble went today? Sunny Bay beach! Splish, splash, hooray!
Pip was SO excited, he zoomed down the sand super-duper fast...
Then, uh-oh! He stepped on slippy seaweed. Sliiiide... SPLOOF! Right into a pile of sand!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Ptooey! I'm okay! I'm a sandy fox now!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Hee-hee! Pip, the sun is out. Let's have fun!
Did you hear that? Sun... fun! They sound the same at the end. That's called a RHYME!

narration.text: Tumble built a tall, tall sandcastle tower. Pat, pat, pat!
Pip found pretty pink shells to make it beautiful.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Let's play the rhyme game, Tumble! What rhymes with SHELL?

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Ooh, I know! Shell rhymes with... SPAGHETTI!
Hee-hee! Spaghetti? No, silly Tumble! Can YOU think of a word that rhymes with shell? It goes ding-dong!
BELL! Shell and bell! You're so smart!

narration.text: Next, Pip wanted to kick his big stripy beach ball.
Kick number one... WHIFF! He missed! Kick number two... WHIFF! He spun round and round like a top!
Kick number three... BOING! The ball flew up, up, UP...
...and landed right on top of Tumble's tall tower. KA-BOOM!

narration.text: HONK! Oh no! My tower!

narration.text: Tumble's tower was just a sandy lump now. His big ears drooped down, down, down.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Oopsie! Um... look, boats! Bye-bye!
And Pip zoomed away... without saying one single word to Tumble.
Hmm. Did Pip forget something important? Poor Tumble sat all alone.

popups.sub: boat, goat and coat all rhyme!

narration.text: Pip ran to the little harbour. Red boats, blue boats, bobbing boats!
And look! On the blue boat sat a goat... wearing a red coat!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Ha-ha! A goat in a coat on a boat! Boat, goat, coat! They all rhyme!
But then Pip's tummy felt all wibble-wobbly. He kept thinking about Tumble's droopy ears.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Hmm. My tummy feels funny. I'll go and ask Nana Hoot.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Nana Hoot, I knocked down Tumble's castle and ran away. Now my tummy feels wobbly.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Ah, little one. When we hurt a friend, the very best thing to do is... zzzz...
Uh-oh! Nana fell asleep! Her glasses slid right down her beak. Pip tapped her wing. Tap, tap!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: I'm awake! Hoo-hoo-HOO! The best thing is to say sorry... and help to fix it.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Sorry! I'll make Tumble a super-duper sorry RHYME!

narration.text: Pip raced all the way back. Zoom, zoom, zoom!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Tumble, I'm sorry I knocked your castle down. Let's build it again, the best in town!
Did you hear Pip's sorry rhyme? Down rhymes with...?
TOWN! Down and town! Hooray!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Thank you, Pip. I forgive you! Let's build it together!

narration.text: Pip filled the buckets. Tumble patted the sand. Pat, pat, pat! The castle grew tall... and TALLER!
Then a little bit of sand tickled Tumble's trunk. AH... AH... AH...
AH-CHOOOO! The giant sneeze blew Pip's red flag right up to the very top of the tower!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Oopsie-trunk! I mean... ta-da!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Tall rhymes with ball! Our castle is the tallest of all!

FUN! Sun and fun!

BELL! Shell and bell! You're a rhyming superstar!

narration.text: That night, the friends sat by their giant sandcastle under the twinkly moon.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: When I make a mistake, a sorry I'll make!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: And a castle we'll bake! Um... I mean, BUILD!
Hee-hee! And Nana Hoot? She was snoring. Goodnight, Sunny Bay!
